log.note:
T194 (W5 A1) -- one indent and icons for Research rows. Agent agent-e586. Status CLAIMED.

WHAT CHANGED
1. src/components/ProjectSidebar.tsx
   - Collection rows now render a leading 16 px icon (new `CollectionRowIcon` +
     `collectionRowIcon` helper, placed above `ProjectSidebar`). Icon by row:
     `pdf:` id -> FileText, `bibliography` -> Library, group `comments` ->
     MessageSquare, group `history` -> History, a research row whose `detail` is a
     note kind -> StickyNote, otherwise Book (source). `History` and `MessageSquare`
     were already imported; `Book`, `Library`, `StickyNote` are new and all exist in
     lucide-react 0.468 (checked by importing the package).
   - Extracted the inline `collectionItems` item shape to a named `CollectionRow`
     type so the helper and Props share one definition. No behaviour change.
   - The icon is the first child of `.entry-main`; `button { gap: var(--space-2) }`
     supplies the 8 px gap, so a label starts 16 + 8 px right of the row padding --
     exactly what Manuscript rows already did.
2. src/styles.css
   - `.entry-row[data-depth="1"] .entry-main`: `calc(var(--space-3) + var(--space-4))`
     -> `calc(var(--space-2) + var(--space-4))`, i.e. 24 px. The base padding is now
     8 px (the later `.entry-main` rule at ~1687), so depth-1 = base + 16 px, which is
     the plan's "measure, do not guess" requirement. Measured: 44 -> 60 px label x.
   - ONE RULE BEYOND THE PLAN'S LINE LIST, deliberate: `.cards-view .entry-row[data-depth="1"] .entry-main`
     with `calc(var(--space-3) + var(--space-4))`. Cards view pads rows by --space-3,
     so without it the PDF card's step would shrink from 16 px to 12 px. It sits in the
     row-rules block the task owns (:1683-1692 region). Say so if you would rather it go.
3. tests/alignment.spec.ts
   - Three new specs (one per sidebar width 190/270/390): seeds a section, a fragment,
     a source with a PDF and a note, then asserts (a) each of those six rows has exactly
     one `.entry-main > svg` at 16 px, (b) the label x of the Manuscript, Fragments,
     Bibliography, source and note rows agree within 0.5 px, (c) the PDF row's label is
     exactly 16 px further right. Added `type Locator` to the import.

CAVEAT THE REVIEWER AND A2 SHOULD KNOW
The sidebar cannot see `project.research`, and App.tsx is A2's hotspot, so sources and
notes are told apart by `detail`: App.tsx:2003-2007 sets `detail: n.kind` on note rows and
nothing on source rows. `collectionRowIcon` treats `detail` as a note only when it is one
of `ResearchNote["kind"]` ("quote" | "paraphrase" | "personal"), so any other detail value
falls back to the source icon instead of mislabelling a source as a note. If A2 touches the
`collectionItems` construction it may pass an explicit kind instead; the helper is one
function to change. Manifested in the done note so it is not rediscovered.

HOW VERIFIED (all on the pinned Node v22.23.3)

  research-row icon) against this build: the new assertions fail with the numbers the
  owner saw -- label x 44, 44, 20, 20, 20 and pdf 40; spread 24 px > 0.5. Log:
  node_modules/.cache/personal-word-beta/ui5-a1/failfirst/ (spec rows-on-old-tree.spec.js,
  config failfirst.config.mjs, results under failfirst-results/).
- ACCEPTANCE: `npx playwright test -c .../ui5-a1/browser.config.mjs tests/alignment.spec.ts
  tests/sidebar-selection.spec.ts tests/layout.spec.ts tests/research-pdf.spec.ts` ->
  33 passed, 0 failed, 0 flaky (report.json in the same folder). Includes the three new
  specs and the pre-existing depth/band/hit-area specs.
- UNIT: `npx vitest run src/designTokens.test.ts src/hoverEmphasis.test.ts src/motion.test.ts`
  -> 36 passed (no new hover rule, so hoverEmphasis is untouched).
- TYPES: `npx tsc --noEmit -p .` -> exit 0.
- MANUSCRIPT LABEL DID NOT MOVE (your instruction): manuscript/fragment label x is 44 px
  both in the doctored pre-A1 run and in the A1 build; every depth-0 row now reports 44 and
  the PDF row 60. Numbers logged by the shots run.
- SCREENSHOTS VIEWED (not just counted), all five: rows-270-{light,dark}-{plain,color}.png
  and rows-190-light-plain.png in .../ui5-a1/shots/. What I saw: greyscale icons in Plain,
  research icons taking the orange section tint in Color (matching the group title's icon,
  via the existing rule at styles.css ~2206), the PDF row one step in, and at 190 px the long
  source title truncating with an ellipsis while every label keeps its x. No new hover rule,
  no fills, no motion.

NOT DONE / LIMITS
- Chromium only: no native WebKit screenshot for this task. The change is padding, icon
  presence and colour inheritance, but per AGENTS.md that is not proof of macOS rendering;
  wave 5 N1/V cover native screenshots.
- Comments and History rows got icons too (generic icons) but are NOT asserted by the new
  spec (seeding a comment/snapshot row was out of A1's acceptance list).
- Prettier was run over the three files by mistake mid-task and the files were restored from
  HEAD and the edits re-applied, so the diff is only A1's lines (54/10/141). No other agent's
  work was in those files at the time (they were clean at HEAD when I started).
